apply: r8 training and val pools drop every manifest row whose source_id is listed under any source below. These rows exist only for data/eval_r8_test (results_r2/r8/testset/PROTOCOL.md).

drone.group: recording: source_id minus its trailing _NNN_ chunk index
drone.caveat: inferred: adjacent recordings of one family may share a flight session, and the mixed_* families may reuse clean drone audio; independence holds at the recording-file level only

noisex92.rule: hold out three defence recordings whose same-type sibling stays in training: buccaneer2 (sibling buccaneer1), m109 (sibling leopard), destroyerengine (sibling destroyerops)

ears.rule: hold out the whole train-split speaker with the smallest manifests.stable_hash(group_id); the test set uses its *_loud clips (the val speaker stays in val)

mad.rule: the video-grouped, speech-filtered mad_v2 test split; the older folder-grouped mad.parquet put some of these videos in train, so they are excluded from any MAD manifest by source_id

freesound_dns_datasets_fullband.noise_fu.group: Freesound upload id parsed from source_id (scripts/heldout_freesound.py FS_ID)
freesound_dns_datasets_fullband.noise_fu.rule: hold out train/val rows whose Freesound id is one of the 398 ids among data/eval_r8_test/test/index.csv noise/impulse sources
freesound_dns_datasets_fullband.noise_fu.caveat: inferred: one Freesound id is one recording (DNS chunks _0.._N of an id are consecutive cuts of it)

freesound_esc50.group: Freesound upload id parsed from source_id (scripts/heldout_freesound.py FS_ID)
freesound_esc50.rule: hold out train/val rows whose Freesound id is one of the 398 ids among data/eval_r8_test/test/index.csv noise/impulse sources
freesound_esc50.caveat: inferred: one Freesound id is one recording (DNS chunks _0.._N of an id are consecutive cuts of it)
